profiles.name: Balanced 1080p
profiles.description: Target for 1920×1080 and 6 GB VRAM systems. Research candidates remain disabled until individually verified, tested and installed.

profiles.name: Visual Priority
profiles.description: A future visual-first profile. Never combine competing full graphics overhauls without a tested compatibility matrix.

profiles.name: Performance Priority
profiles.description: A future low-overhead profile. Enable only packages with measured performance impact.

profiles.name: Story Expansion
profiles.description: A future gameplay/story profile. Enable only tested single-player packages with pinned dependencies.

profiles.name: Story & World Expansion
profiles.description: Prioritises compatible single-player story expansions, side missions, activities, interiors and ambient world systems. Every mission pack must be tested for save compatibility and load order.

profiles.name: Accessibility & Comfort
profiles.description: Prioritises readable UI, subtitle clarity, control flexibility, camera comfort, audio clarity and other verified accessibility improvements. Native game settings are preferred over risky modifications.

cataloguePolicy: Third-party binaries are not bundled unless redistribution is explicitly permitted. See docs/MOD_CATALOGUE_POLICY.md.
